chapters.text: Upload the statement and see money that moved with no entry, and entries with no bank line.
Add the bank (or JazzCash / Easypaisa) account as a money holder of type Bank account.
Download the statement as Excel or CSV and upload it here for that account.
Lines are matched automatically (same amount, within 3 days).
For a line with no entry, choose a category and click Add entry, or Ignore it.
